column1: # Request target → scanner family, or empty when the path is not a probe,
# as both stats/classify.go (Go) and caddylog (Rust) must answer it.
# Real routes on these hosts are not probes, however they are spelled.
# one_d4's real admin route; "admin" is not a family.
# An HTTP clone, not a dotdir probe.
# Forgejo serves archives and raw files with backup-looking extensions,
# always several segments deep; backups probe the root.
# An escape is only a spelling, so it does not hide a family. Dot segments
# are the opposite: they are what traversal is looking for, which is why
# the path these read is decoded and not cleaned.
